name: @lkvip/mobile
description: LKVIP Mobile — Capacitor wrapper cho tất cả SPA (admin, hub, game, trading, dating, sports). Chọn target bằng MOBILE_TARGET env.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.build:admin: MOBILE_TARGET=admin   pnpm --filter @lkvip/admin   run build && npx cap sync
scripts.build:hub: MOBILE_TARGET=hub     pnpm --filter @lkvip/hub     run build && npx cap sync
scripts.build:game: MOBILE_TARGET=game    pnpm --filter @lkvip/game    run build && npx cap sync
scripts.build:trading: MOBILE_TARGET=trading pnpm --filter @lkvip/trade   run build && npx cap sync
scripts.build:dating: MOBILE_TARGET=dating  pnpm --filter @lkvip/dating  run build && npx cap sync
scripts.build:sports: MOBILE_TARGET=sports  pnpm --filter @lkvip/sports  run build && npx cap sync
